cases.title: Scenario matrix row for student authentication gate before check-in
preconditions: Testing-plan §12 Student check-in validation row applies (FR-15, FR-16, FR-17, FR-18, FR-22, FR-23; BR-05, BR-06, BR-07, BR-11, BR-12, BR-23; AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-11, AC-18).
Main-workflows §5.5 Login gate checkpoint applies (AC-06).
An Open class session exists with a valid QR token and enrolled student fixture available.
steps: Open the student check-in entry path without establishing an authenticated session.
Attempt to proceed to check-in submission.
After successful student login, retry submission with the same check-in context.
cases.expected: Unauthenticated access is blocked with login redirect or Unauthenticated rejection per AC-06; after successful authentication the student can proceed to submit check-in.

cases.title: M01 identity module short-circuits check-in at auth boundary without attendance write
preconditions: Real database transaction is enabled for M01 Identity and Access and M04 Check-in modules.
Open session with valid QR token exists; no authenticated Student actor is bound to the request context.
steps: Invoke the check-in command path with a valid qrToken but no resolved student actor through the M01/M04 integration boundary.
Query CheckInAttempt and AttendanceRecord tables for the target session.
Repeat with authenticated enrolled student actor as control.
cases.expected: Unauthenticated invocation short-circuits at authentication guard (API §5.1 step 1) with outcome Unauthenticated and creates no Present/Late AttendanceRecord; authenticated enrolled student control passes the auth boundary.

cases.title: HTTP contract for student POST /v1/auth/login then GET /v1/me
preconditions: A provisioned student account with institution-issued credentials exists in the test environment.
No active bearer token is held by the test client.
steps: Send POST /v1/auth/login with student email and password.
Assert HTTP 200 and standard envelope with data.accessToken, data.expiresInSeconds, and data.roles containing Student.
Send GET /v1/me with Authorization Bearer accessToken from the login response.
Assert HTTP 200 with data reflecting the student actor identity and Student role scope claims.
cases.expected: Login returns HTTP 200 with accessToken and Student role; GET /v1/me returns HTTP 200 with the authenticated student identity and scope, establishing the session context required by FR-15 before check-in.

cases.title: HTTP contract for unauthenticated POST /v1/check-ins rejection
preconditions: Open class session with valid qrToken exists in test environment.
Request is sent without Authorization header.
steps: Call POST /v1/check-ins with body containing qrToken and clientTimestamp and required Idempotency-Key header.
Omit Authorization header entirely.
Inspect HTTP status, response envelope data/meta/error fields.
cases.expected: API returns 401 with standard envelope where data is null and error.code is Unauthenticated per API §5.1 step 1; no successful attendance outcome is returned.

cases.title: Primary workflow login gate then successful student check-in
preconditions: Open session with rotating valid QR token and enrolled student account exist.
Student begins FLOW-01 without an active auth session.
steps: Student obtains check-in URL or token from QR scan while unauthenticated.
Student completes POST /v1/auth/login and receives accessToken with Student role.
Student calls POST /v1/check-ins with Authorization Bearer token, valid qrToken, clientTimestamp, and Idempotency-Key within present window.
cases.expected: Authentication gate is satisfied first per main-workflows §5.5; subsequent check-in returns 200 with data.outcome Success and attendance status Present or Late per policy.

cases.title: RBAC denial when non-student roles attempt QR check-in submission
preconditions: Open session with valid qrToken exists.
Lecturer and ITAdmin users are authenticated with valid bearer tokens.
Permission matrix §3.1 Submit QR check-in allows Student only.
steps: Lecturer calls POST /v1/check-ins with valid qrToken, clientTimestamp, Idempotency-Key, and Authorization header.
ITAdmin calls POST /v1/check-ins with the same token context.
Enrolled Student calls the same endpoint as authorized control.
cases.expected: Lecturer and ITAdmin receive authorization denial (403 Forbidden) per permission matrix and API §6.2; enrolled Student passes the auth gate and proceeds to business validation.

cases.title: Boundary error for invalid or expired bearer token on check-in
preconditions: Open session with valid qrToken exists.
Test client holds an expired or malformed JWT bearer token.
steps: Call POST /v1/check-ins with Authorization Bearer set to expired token, valid qrToken, clientTimestamp, and Idempotency-Key.
Call POST /v1/check-ins with Authorization Bearer set to malformed token and the same payload fields.
Inspect HTTP status and error.code for both requests.
cases.expected: Both requests fail authentication with 401 and error.code Unauthenticated in the standard envelope; no attendance success row is created.

cases.title: UI journey redirects unauthenticated student to login and returns to check-in
preconditions: Student check-in deep link or QR-resolved URL is available for an Open session.
Browser profile has no active Attendly session cookie.
steps: Navigate directly to PG-02 check-in URL (/check-in?token=...) without logging in per FLOW-01 step 1.
Verify redirect to PG-01 login with returnUrl preserved where supported (FLOW-01 step 2).
Submit valid student credentials on FRM-01 login form.
Confirm browser returns to PG-02 check-in page with prior token context retained.
Complete check-in submission from the restored check-in UI.
cases.expected: Unauthenticated visit cannot submit check-in; login form accepts credentials; post-login navigation returns student to check-in flow with token context preserved and enables submission per FR-15.

cases.title: Check-in attempt terminates at Unauthenticated without attendance mutation
preconditions: Open class session with valid qrToken exists in integration test database.
Request context has no resolved Student actor (missing or invalid Authorization).
steps: Capture beforeState: no Present/Late AttendanceRecord for the target session and no authenticated student actor bound.
Submit check-in command with valid qrToken through the module integration boundary without Authorization.
Capture afterState for session roster rows and any persisted attempt records.
cases.expected: Validation order short-circuits at Unauthenticated as the first guard per API §5.1 step 1; afterState shows no Present/Late AttendanceRecord mutation and the API layer returns 401 with error.code Unauthenticated.

cases.title: FRM-01 login form validates inline, shows submitting state, and returns to check-in after success
preconditions: Student arrives at PG-01 login via redirect from PG-02 check-in deep link with returnUrl preserved.
Browser profile has no active Attendly session cookie.
Open class session with valid QR token exists for post-login return context.
steps: Submit FRM-01 with empty email and password fields and observe required-field inline errors per 08-forms-validation-ux §4.1.
Enter malformed email format and observe format validation message without server round-trip.
Enter valid credentials and observe submitting state disables the sign-in control with loading indicator.
On successful authentication confirm browser navigates back to PG-02 with prior token query parameter retained.
Enter invalid credentials and observe form-level alert mapping 401 Unauthenticated without silent redirect loop or account-enumerating field-specific hints.
cases.expected: FRM-01 enforces required and format inline validation, disabled submitting feedback during POST /v1/auth/login, form-level error alert on auth failure, and post-success return to check-in per FR-15 and 08-forms-validation-ux §4.1.

cases.title: PG-02 authenticating visual state blocks premature check-in submission before login
preconditions: Open class session with valid QR token exists; check-in deep link /check-in?token=... is available.
Browser profile has no active Attendly session cookie.
Student mobile shell (SUR-01) viewport at 375px width per NFR-14.
steps: Navigate to PG-02 check-in URL with token query parameter while unauthenticated.
Observe transient authenticating visual state per 09-page-list §3 PG-02 key states (authenticating redirect to /login) before landing on PG-01.
On PG-01 confirm generic login heading without role-specific copy and FRM-01 guidance intent for check-in return flow.
Verify check-in submit CTA is not reachable and no success-present or success-late visual state appears without completing login.
cases.expected: PG-02 shows distinct authenticating/redirect state distinct from ready-to-submit or success outcome; PG-01 presents neutral FRM-01 login entry; unauthenticated user cannot reach check-in submission UI until auth gate clears per FR-15.
